verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own storage uses an open, standard interface: AI Object Storage offers S3-compatible access and lets you download objects from the Cloud Console. Usage data can be exported through the FOCUS API, and infrastructure sits on standard Kubernetes and Terraform, which supports portability. However, nothing documents a complete 'export all my data' workflow or an exit path. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, egress/exit terms or migration guidance, a GA (not Public Preview) billing export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving with all data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Store training data, checkpoints, and model weights with efficient S3-compatible access directly to your GPU compute resources.
You can now browse, upload, download, and manage objects in CoreWeave AI Object Storage buckets directly from the CoreWeave Cloud Console
You can also export usage programmatically with the FOCUS API (Public Preview)
